settings.aboutText: Our Home is an original, offline-first cozy game made for slow afternoons. Decorate nine rooms, grow a little garden, cook for the ones you love, and keep a photo album of small moments.
settings.privacyText: No accounts are required to play. No ads, purchases or tracking. Your game is saved on this device. Cloud save is opt-in and uses an email sign-in; only your save data is stored.
settings.musicCredit: Music and sounds were synthesised for this game.
settings.artCredit: All art is drawn from original shapes and colours.
settings.dataCredit: Built with open-source tools. No third-party game assets are used.

visitor.pip.name: Pip
visitor.pip.line: The tea is warm and the window is sunny. May I stay a while?
visitor.miso.name: Miso
visitor.miso.line: I brought nothing but my appetite. Is that all right?
visitor.juniper.name: Juniper
visitor.juniper.line: Your garden smells like the first day of autumn.
visitor.basil.name: Basil
visitor.basil.line: I found a quiet corner by the flowers. Perfect.
visitor.tilly.name: Tilly
visitor.tilly.line: A little pond, a little bread, a very good afternoon.
visitor.odette.name: Odette
visitor.odette.line: I heard there was something sweet in the garden.
visitor.clover.name: Clover
visitor.clover.line: Your rug is the softest thing I have ever sat on.
visitor.pepper.name: Pepper
visitor.pepper.line: I am not here for the snacks. I am here for the atmosphere. And the snacks.
visitor.nori.name: Nori
visitor.nori.line: That pond looks inviting. Do you mind if I dangle my feet?
visitor.sunny.name: Sunny
visitor.sunny.line: Good morning! The hens told me this was the friendliest house.
visitor.bramble.name: Bramble
visitor.bramble.line: I brought a leaf. It is a very nice leaf. It is for you.
visitor.sageOwl.name: Sage
visitor.sageOwl.line: I mostly come for the quiet. And the books.
visitor.momo.name: Momo
visitor.momo.line: I have inspected your sofa. It passes.
visitor.button.name: Button
visitor.button.line: Everything here is so soft. May I stay for a nap?
visitor.puddle.name: Puddle
visitor.puddle.line: The bathroom tap has the most wonderful drip.
visitor.pebble.name: Pebble
visitor.pebble.line: No hurry. I have all afternoon.
visitor.marigold.name: Marigold
visitor.marigold.line: Your flowers are showing off today. I approve.
visitor.honey.name: Honey
visitor.honey.line: I followed the smell of something baking. Was that rude?
visitor.biscuit.name: Biscuit
visitor.biscuit.line: Hello! I have brought enthusiasm and very little else.
visitor.snowdrop.name: Snowdrop
visitor.snowdrop.line: The light in this room is exactly right.
visitor.acorn.name: Acorn
visitor.acorn.line: I am collecting nice afternoons. This is one.
visitor.dahlia.name: Dahlia
visitor.dahlia.line: A flower for your table, if you will have it.
visitor.bruno.name: Bruno
visitor.bruno.line: Big house. Bigger heart. I like it here.
visitor.clementine.name: Clementine
visitor.clementine.line: I have found the sunniest patch of floor. It is mine now.

about.title: Our Home
about.body: A small, original, offline-first game about making a home with someone. No ads, no purchases, no tracking. Just rooms, plants, pets, visitors and a recipe book.
about.madeWith: Made with care for slow days.

privacy.localBody: Your house, photos and settings live in this browser. Clearing site data removes them, so keep a backup from Settings if you would like to move house.
privacy.cloudBody: If cloud save is enabled, signing in with an email stores only your save file so you can continue on another device. It is off by default and never required.
privacy.trackingBody: There are no ads, purchases, analytics or third-party trackers. The game makes no network requests except to load its own files and, if you choose, your cloud save.
